duas.context: When waking up in the morning
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushur
duas.text: Praise be to Allah who has given us life after having given us death, and to Him will we return

duas.context: When starting to study or seek knowledge
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا وَذِكْرًا مُتَصَلًى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'an wa'amalan mutaqabbala wa-dhikran mutasalla
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, accepted deeds, and continuous remembrance

duas.context: When feeling overwhelmed with work or responsibilities
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لا طَاقَةَ إِلَّا بِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la taqata illa bika
duas.text: O Allah, there is no strength except by You

duas.context: When traveling or going on a journey
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma hawwin alayna safarana hadha watwi anna bu'dahu
duas.text: O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance

duas.context: When eating or before meals
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi wa barakatihu
duas.text: In the name of Allah and with His blessings

duas.context: When experiencing physical pain or sickness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَذْهِبْ عَنِّي الْبَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ وَاشْفِ أَنتَ الشَّافِي لا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma adhhib anni al-ba'sa rabban-nasi washfi anta shafi la shifa'a illa shifa'uka
duas.text: O Allah, remove from me the hardship, O Lord of the people, and heal me, You are the Healer, there is no healing except Your healing

duas.context: When going to sleep or before bedtime
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi amutu wa-ahya
duas.text: In the name of Allah I die and I live

duas.context: When waking up during the night
duas.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahul-mulku wa-lahul-hamdu wa-huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
duas.text: There is no god except Allah, alone, without partners, to Him belongs the kingdom and to Him belongs the praise, and He is capable of all things

duas.context: When making a decision or seeking guidance
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ فَإِنَّكَ تَقِفُ عَلَى غَيْبِ الْجَنَانِ وَإِنَّكَ تَقِفُ عَلَى غَيْبِ الْجِنَانِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika fa-innaka taqifu ala ghaybi al-janan wa-innaka taqifu ala ghaybi al-jinan
duas.text: O Allah, I seek Your counsel, for You know the unseen of the heavens and the earth

duas.context: When feeling anxious or worried about the future
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْخَيْرِ رُشْدِي وَخَيْرَ عَاقِبَةٍ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِ الشَرِّ وَسُوءِ عَاقِبَةٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma as'aluka khayral-khayri rushdi wa-khayra aaqibatin wa-a'udhu bika min sharri sharrin wa-su'aa aqibatin
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for the best of good, my guidance, and the best of outcomes, and I seek refuge in You from the worst of evil and the worst of outcomes

duas.context: When experiencing sadness or grief
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُزَعِ وَالْهَمِّ وَالْأَزَمَةِ وَالْبُكَاءِ وَالْجَزَعِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-juzi wal-hammi wal-azamati wal-buka'i wal-jaz'i
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from despair, anxiety, and crying

duas.context: When seeking protection from evil or harm
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفسٍ وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ عَينٍ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahil-azimi min sharri kulli dhi sharrin wa-min sharri kulli nafsin wa-min sharri kulli ain
duas.text: I seek refuge in Allah, the Great, from the evil of every evil thing, and from the evil of every soul, and from the evil of every eye

duas.context: When entering a new place or home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلِجَنَابِهِ وَالصَلاَةُ وَالسَلاَمُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi wa-lajanabihi was-salatu was-salamu ala rasulillah
duas.text: In the name of Allah, and by His noble presence, and blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah

duas.context: When seeking forgiveness for past mistakes
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa-ana abduka wa-ana ala ahdika wa-wa'dika ma-istata'tu
duas.text: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god except You, You created me, and I am Your servant, and I am on Your covenant and Your promise as much as I can

duas.context: When seeking guidance in times of confusion
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-huda wat-tuqa wal-afafa wal-ghina
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and richness

duas.context: When facing difficulties or challenges
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la takilni ila nafsi tarfata aymin wa-aslih li sha'ni kullahu
duas.text: O Allah, do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye, and correct all my affairs

duas.context: When seeking blessings and prosperity
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَعِزْنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aghnini bi-halalika an haramika wa-a'izni bi-fadlika amman siwak
duas.text: O Allah, enrich me with Your lawful provisions, and make me independent of what is forbidden, and honor me with Your favor above those besides You

duas.context: When experiencing fear or apprehension
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخَوفِ وَالْجُزَعِ وَالْعِجَزِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khufi wal-juzi wal-ijzi wal-bukhli wal-jubni
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from fear, despair, inability, stinginess, and cowardice

duas.context: When seeking protection from evil eye or envy
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ شَرِّ حَسَدِهِمْ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ لِنَفْسِي مِنْ شَرِّ عَيْنِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika lil-mu'minina min sharri hasadihim wa-a'udhu bika li-nafsi min sharri aynee
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You for the believers from the evil of their envy, and I seek refuge in You for myself from the evil of my own eye

duas.context: When entering a mosque or place of worship
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالسَلاَمُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi was-salamu ala rasulillah Allahumma iftah li abwaba rahmatik
duas.text: In the name of Allah, and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy

duas.context: When leaving a gathering or meeting
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لَنَا ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslih lana dhati baynina wa-tub alayna innaka anta tawwabur-rahim
duas.text: O Allah, correct our mutual relations, and turn to us, for You are the One who accepts repentance, the Most Merciful

duas.context: When seeking knowledge or understanding
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاِحْدِثْنِي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَافْتَحْ لِي مِنْ عِلْمِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma fa-hdithni min fadlika wa-ftah li min ilmik
duas.text: O Allah, bestow upon me from Your bounty, and open for me from Your knowledge

duas.context: When feeling grateful or thankful
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَنْعَمَ عَلَيَّ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ شَكَرَ وَذَكَرَ
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi an'ama alayya wa-qad aflaha man shakara wa-dhakara
duas.text: Praise be to Allah who has blessed me, and he who is grateful and remembers will be successful

duas.context: When seeking help or support
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنِي بِفَضْلِكَ وَاِسْعِدْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَاِجْمَعْ لِي بِرِزْقِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aghithni bi-fadlika wa-s'idni bi-rahmatika wa-jma' li bi-rizqik
duas.text: O Allah, help me with Your bounty, make me happy with Your mercy, and bring together for me Your provision

duas.context: When experiencing hardship or tribulation
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا عَذَابَ إِلَّا عَذَابُكَ وَلَا نَصْرَ إِلَّا نَصْرُكَ وَلَا رُخَاءَ إِلَّا رُخَاؤُكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la azaba illa azabuka wa-la nasra illa nasruka wa-la rukha'a illa rukha'uka
duas.text: O Allah, there is no punishment except Your punishment, no victory except Your victory, no ease except Your ease

duas.context: When departing from a friend or loved one
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَشْكُو إِلَيْكَ فِقْدَ أَهْلِنَا وَمَضِيَ أَصْحَابِنَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inna nashku ilayka fiqda ahlina wa-madiya ashabina
duas.text: O Allah, we complain to You the loss of our family and the departure of our companions

duas.context: When waking up for Tahajjud prayer
duas.arabic: لَابَسْتُ ثَوْبَيْ رِضَا مِنْ رَبِّي
duas.transliteration: Labistu thawbay rida min rabbi
duas.text: I have put on the two garments of my Lord's satisfaction

duas.context: For protection from evil eye
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimati Allahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.text: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created

duas.context: When studying or seeking knowledge
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي بِالْعِلْمِ وَزَيِّنِي بِالْهُدَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma arhamni bil-ilmi wazayyinni bil-huda
duas.text: O Allah, have mercy on me with knowledge and adorn me with guidance

duas.context: For relief from debt
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَخْسِ عَنِّي الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنِي مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma akhsi 'anni ad-dayna wa aghnini minal-faqri
duas.text: O Allah, remove from me the debt and make me self-sufficient from poverty

duas.context: When experiencing pain or discomfort
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ اِشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rabbannasi adhhibil-ba'sa ishfi wa anta ash-shafi
duas.text: O Allah, Lord of the people, remove the pain and heal, You are the Healer

duas.context: For guidance in decision making
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْحَوَايَا وَخَيْرَ الْمَصِيرِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayral-hawaya wa khayral-masiri
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for the best of conditions and the best of outcomes

duas.context: When traveling by sea or boat
duas.arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Ma sha' Allah la quwwata illa billah
duas.text: What Allah wills, there is no power except with Allah

duas.context: For protection from harm while traveling
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ سِرْ في سِيَرِ السَّلَامَةِ وَأَنْزِلْ في مَنْزِلِ الْأَمَانِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma sir fi siyari as-salamati wa anzil fi manzili al-amani
duas.text: O Allah, make me travel in the way of safety and lodge me in the abode of security

duas.context: When experiencing financial difficulties
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْقِلَّةِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-faqri wal-qillati
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty and scarcity

duas.context: For the blessing of one's children
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِي أَوْلَادِي وَاجْعَلْهُمْ لِي قُرَّةً أَعْيُنٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik li fi awladi waj'alhum li qurrata a'yunin
duas.text: O Allah, bless me in my children and make them a source of joy for me

duas.context: When visiting a sick person
duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: La ba'sa tahuran in sha' Allah
duas.text: No harm, purity from Allah will, if Allah wills

duas.context: For relief from a difficult situation
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa Allah al-azimu al-halim
duas.text: There is no deity except Allah, the Great, the Forbearing

duas.context: When eating with others
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fimma razaqtana wa qina adhaba an-nar
duas.text: O Allah, bless us in what You have provided us and protect us from the punishment of the Fire

duas.context: For protection from the evil of one's own self
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self

duas.context: When going to the mosque for prayer
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aj'al fi qalbi nuran wa fi sam'i nuran
duas.text: O Allah, make a light in my heart and a light in my hearing

duas.context: For the guidance of non-Muslim relatives
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ عَبَدَتَكَ فُلاَنَةَ بِنْتَ فُلاَنٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ihdi abdatika fulanata bint fulanin
duas.text: O Allah, guide Your servant, so-and-so daughter of so-and-so

duas.context: When experiencing sadness or grief
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un
duas.text: To Allah we belong and to Him we will return

duas.context: For protection from the devil during sleep
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ
duas.transliteration: Bismi Allah alladhi la yadurru ma'a ismihi shay'un
duas.text: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing can harm

duas.context: When waking up from sleep
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillah alladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana
duas.text: Praise be to Allah who has given us life after He had caused us to die

duas.context: For the well-being of one's spouse
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الزَّوْجَةِ وَخَيْرَ ما جِيءَ بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayral-zawjati wa khayra ma ji'a bihi
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for the best of the spouse and the best of what she brings

duas.context: When experiencing fear or anxiety
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَفَى بِكَ وَهَنِيءً بِدِينِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma kafaka wa hanian bidinika
duas.text: O Allah, You are sufficient for me and Your religion is a source of pride

duas.context: For protection from the evil eye of others
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقْصِمْ عَنِّي أَبَصَارَ الْمُبْطِلِينَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aqsim 'anni absara al-mubtilin
duas.text: O Allah, break the gaze of the envious from me

duas.context: When feeling overwhelmed or stressed
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجَزَعِ وَالْهَمِّ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-jaza'i wal-hammi
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from distress and anxiety

duas.context: For the guidance of one's children
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ وَلَدِيَ وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَهُمْ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ihdi waladi wa thabbit aqdamahum
duas.text: O Allah, guide my children and make their feet firm

duas.context: When experiencing difficulties in one's life
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.transliteration: Ya hayyu ya qayyumu bi-rahmatika astagheethu
duas.text: O Living, O Sustaining, I seek help through Your mercy

duas.context: For the forgiveness of one's sins
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذَّنْبَ الْعَظِيمَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ighfir li adh-dhanba al-azim
duas.text: O Allah, forgive me the great sin

duas.context: When waking up at night
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَٰحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahul-mulku walahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir
duas.text: There is no deity except Allah, the One. He has no partner. To Him belongs the kingdom, and to Him belongs all praise. He is capable of everything

duas.context: When starting a new project or task
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ اَلرَّحِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahir-rahmanir-rahim
duas.text: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate

duas.context: When feeling overwhelmed with tasks
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لا تُحَمِّلْنِي مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لِي بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la tuhammilni ma la taqata li bih
duas.text: O Allah, do not burden me with what I have no capacity for

duas.context: When experiencing financial difficulties
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma kifini bihalalika an haramika wa aghnini bifadlika amman siwak
duas.text: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful, so that I may not be in need of what You have made unlawful, and make me independent of means by Your bounty, beyond the need of others

duas.context: When traveling by land
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا صَحْبِي فَأَغِثْنِي عَلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma hadha sahbi fa aghithni alayh
duas.text: O Allah, this is my companion, so help me in regards to him

duas.context: When looking for a spouse
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الزَوْجَةِ وَخَيْرَ ما تُجْمَعُ بِهِ الزَوْجَةُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraz-zawjati wa khayra ma tujma'u bihi zawjat
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for the best of wives and the best of what brings a wife together

duas.context: When having a disagreement with someone
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslih li dini alladhi huwa ismatu amri wa aslih li dunyaya allati fiha maashi
duas.text: O Allah, correct my religion for me, which is the safeguard of my affairs, and correct my worldly life, in which is my livelihood

duas.context: When feeling sad or depressed
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ عَلَيْنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rabbana atmim alayna nurana waghfir lana innaka ala kulli shayin qadir
duas.text: O Allah, our Lord, perfect our light for us, and forgive us. Indeed, You are capable of all things

duas.context: When studying or seeking knowledge
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا وَذِكْرًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'an wa amalan mutaqabbalan wa dhikran mutaqabbal
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, accepted deeds, and accepted remembrance

duas.context: When making a decision
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا هُوَ لَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا هُوَ بِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا هُوَ لَهُ وَشَرِّ مَا هُوَ بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayrah wa khayra ma huwa lahu wa khayra ma huwa bih wa a'udhu bika min sharrih wa sharri ma huwa lahu wa sharri ma huwa bih
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for its goodness, the goodness of what it is, and the goodness of what it contains. I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of what it is, and the evil of what it contains

duas.context: When visiting a sick person
duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun in shaa' Allahu
duas.text: No harm, purification from Allah will come, if Allah wills

duas.context: When experiencing physical pain or illness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَذْهِبْ عَنِّي البَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ وَاشْفِ أَنتَ الشَّافِي لَا شَافِيَ إِلَّا أَنتَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma adhhib anni al-ba'sa rabbannasi washfi anta ash-shafi la shafiya illa anta shifa'an la yughadiru saqaman
duas.text: O Allah, remove the pain, O Lord of the people, and heal, You are the Healer, there is no healing except from You, a healing that leaves no disease

duas.context: When going to the mosque for prayer
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا وَعَنْ شِمَالي نُورًا وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُورًا وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ij'al fi qalbi nuran wa fi sam'i nuran wa fi basari nuran wa min fawqi nuran wa min tahti nuran wa an yamini nuran wa an shamali nuran wa min amami nuran wa min khalfi nuran wa ij'al li nuran
duas.text: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light from above me, light from below me, light on my right, light on my left, light in front of me, light behind me, and grant me light

duas.context: When entering a market or place of business
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahul-mulku walahul-hamdu yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir
duas.text: There is no deity except Allah, the One. He has no partner. To Him belongs the kingdom, and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life, and He causes death. He is capable of all things

duas.context: When experiencing difficulties or hardships
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْعُصْرُ وَلَكَ الْأَمْرُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ أَكُونَ وَهَذَا أَمْرِي الَّذِي أَنَا فِيهِ فَاقْدِرْ عَلَيَّ مِنْهُ مَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma laka al-usru wala kal-amru min qabli an akoona wa hadha amri alladhi ana fihi faqdir alayya minh ma anta a'lamu bih
duas.text: O Allah, to You belongs the affair, and to You belongs the command, before I existed. This is my affair, in which I am, so decree for me from it what You know best

duas.context: When seeking protection from harm
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَرِّ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخَمْطِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-sharri wa a'udhu bika minal-khamti wa a'udhu bika minal-jubni wa a'udhu bika minal-bukhli
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil, and I seek refuge in You from laziness, and I seek refuge in You from cowardice, and I seek refuge in You from miserliness

duas.context: When experiencing fear or anxiety
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhli wa a'udhu bika min adhabil-qabri wa a'udhu bika min fitnatil-masihid-dajjal
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from cowardice, and miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of the Antichrist

duas.context: When seeking guidance and wisdom
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَرْشِدْنِي وَهَدِنِي لِمَا يُصْلِحُ أَمْرِي وَزَوْجَتِي وَوَلَدِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma arshidni wahdini lima yuslihu amri wa zawjati wa waladi
duas.text: O Allah, guide me, and direct me to what corrects my affairs, my wife, and my children

duas.context: When experiencing difficulties in marriage
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ أَهْلِي وَخَيْرِ مَا جَمَعْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ خَيْرَ الْمَعَاشِ وَالْمَعَادِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayri ahli wa khayri ma jama'ta bayni wa baynahum khayral-ma'ashi walm-ma'ad
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of my family, and the goodness of what You have brought together between me and them, the goodness of this life and the next

duas.context: When seeking protection from evil eye
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ لِمَا أُحِبُ مِنَ الشَرِّ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفسٍ وَهَظِّ كُلِّ حَاسِدٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika lima uhibbu minash-sharri min sharri kulli nafsin wahazzi kulli hasidin
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You for what I love from evil, from the evil of every soul, and the envy of every envious person

duas.context: When experiencing difficulties with children
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ لِمَوْلُودِيَ الْعَافِيَةَ وَالسَّلَامَةَ وَالْهُدَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka limawludiya al-afiyata was-salamata wal-huda
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for my child well-being, safety, and guidance

duas.context: When seeking forgiveness for oneself and others
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ighfir li wa liwalidayya wali-mu'minina wal-mu'minat wal-muslimina wal-muslimat
duas.text: O Allah, forgive me, and my parents, and the believing men and women, and the Muslim men and women

duas.context: When seeking protection from natural disasters
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الزَلَزِلِ وَمِنَ الزَلازِلِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-zalazili waminal-zalazil
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from earthquakes, and from repeated earthquakes

duas.context: When experiencing difficulties in work or business
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-afwa wal-afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for pardon, and well-being in this life and the next

duas.context: When seeking guidance in making decisions
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-huda wat-tuqa wal-afafa wal-ghina
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency

duas.context: When experiencing difficulties or hardships in old age
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رِزْقًا حَلَالًا وَعِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka rizqan halalan wa ilman nafi'an wa amalan mutaqabbalan
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for lawful provision, beneficial knowledge, and accepted deeds

duas.context: When waking up for Tahajjud
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَي'yَمُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta qayyamus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinna...
duas.text: O Allah, to You belongs all praise. You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is in them...

duas.context: For protection from evil eyes
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri hasidin idha hasada...
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of an envier when he envies...

duas.context: When going to the mosque for prayer
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ij'al fi qalbi nuran wa fi sam'i nuran wa fi basari nuran...
duas.text: O Allah, place light in my heart, and light in my hearing, and light in my sight...

duas.context: For relief from debt
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَخْسِ عَنِّي الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِني مِنَ الْفَقْرِ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma akhsi 'anni ad-dayna wa aghnini minal-faqri...
duas.text: O Allah, remove from me my debt and enrich me from poverty...

duas.context: When starting a new project or endeavor
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ...
duas.transliteration: Bismillah alladhi la yadurru ma'a ismih shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i...
duas.text: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing can cause harm in the earth or in the heavens...

duas.context: For seeking forgiveness for oneself and one's parents
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ighfir li wa liwalidayya wa lilmu'minina wal-mu'minati...
duas.text: O Allah, forgive me and my parents and the believing men and women...

duas.context: When experiencing hardship or difficulty
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju fa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'aynin...
duas.text: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy, so do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye...

duas.context: For protection from the Dajjal
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيْحِ الدَّجَّالِ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabri wa min fitnatil-masihid-dajjali...
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave and from the trial of the Antichrist...

duas.context: When visiting a sick person
duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ...
duas.transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun in shaa'Allah...
duas.text: No harm, purity from Allah will be granted if Allah wills...

duas.context: For guidance in making decisions
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْهَدْيِ وَخَيْرَ الْعَقْلِ وَخَيْرَ التُّقَى...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayral-hadyi wa khayral-'aqli wa khayrat-tuqa...
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for the best guidance, the best intellect, and the best piety...

duas.context: When seeking knowledge or wisdom
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا وَفَهْمًا وَهِدَايَةً...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma zidni 'ilman wa fahman wa hidayah...
duas.text: O Allah, increase me in knowledge, understanding, and guidance...

duas.context: For protection from bad dreams
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهِ وَنَفْخِهِ وَنَفْثِهِ...
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim min hamzih wa nafkhih wa nafthih...
duas.text: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the accursed from his whispers, his puffing, and his spitting...

duas.context: When going to bed
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bismika amutu wa ahya...
duas.text: O Allah, with Your name I die and I live...

duas.context: For seeking blessings in one's food
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنا وَقِنا عَذَابَ النَّارِ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fimar razqtana wa qina 'adhaban-nar...
duas.text: O Allah, bless us in what You have provided for us and protect us from the punishment of the Fire...

duas.context: When seeing a beautiful creation of Allah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ...
duas.transliteration: Allahu akbar Allahu akbar Allahu akbar...
duas.text: Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest...

duas.context: For protection from the temptations of Satan
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشَرَكِهِ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharri ash-shaytani wa sharakih...
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, from the evil of Satan, and from his partners...

duas.context: When experiencing sadness or grief
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَبْكِي لَكَ دَمْعَةً تَرْجُو بِهَا رَحْمَتَكَ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni abki laka dam'atan tarju biha rahmatik...
duas.text: O Allah, I cry to You with tears hoping for Your mercy...

duas.context: For seeking good health
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اشْفِ عَبْدَكَ فَأَصِحْهُ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ كُلِ داءٍ وَسُقْمٍ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ishfi 'abda ka fa asihhu wa a'ithhu min kulli da'in wa suqmin...
duas.text: O Allah, cure Your servant, make him healthy, and protect him from every disease and illness...

duas.context: When leaving the mosque
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik...
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for Your favor...

duas.context: For protection from bad manners and character
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْأَخْلَاقِ الرَّذِيَةِ وَالْأَفْعَالِ السَّيِّئَةِ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-akhlaqir-radiyati wal-af'alis-sai'yati...
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from bad manners and evil deeds...

duas.context: When seeing a Muslim brother or sister
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْزِلْهُ رَحْمَةً وَأَغِثْهُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anzilhu rahmatan wa aghithhu min rahmatik...
duas.text: O Allah, send him mercy and help him with Your mercy...

duas.context: For seeking guidance in times of uncertainty
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ خِرْ لِي وَاخْتَرْ لِي...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma khir li wa khatar li...
duas.text: O Allah, choose for me and select for me...

duas.context: When giving advice or guidance to someone
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَرْشِدْهُ وَاجْمَعْ لَهُ أَمْرَهُ عَلَى الْخَيْرِ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma arshidhu wa jama'a lahu amrahu 'alal-khayr...
duas.text: O Allah, guide him and unite his affairs for good...

duas.context: For protection from the punishment of the grave
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيَحِ الدَّجَّالِ...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabri wa min fitnatil-masihid-dajjali...
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave and from the trial of the Antichrist...

duas.context: When seeking forgiveness for past sins
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ غَفَرَ لِيَ الْذَنْبَ الْعَظِيمَ وَذُنُوبِيَ كُلَّهَا...
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ghafor liyadhanba al-'adheema wa dhunubi kulla ha...
duas.text: O Allah, forgive me the greatest sin and all my sins...

duas.context: When going to the mosque
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْني مُتَوَضِّئًا وَ مُتَطَهِّرًا وَ مُتَقَبَّلَ عَمَلاً
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ij'alni mutawad-di'an wa mutatahhiran wa mutaqabbala amala
duas.text: O Allah, make me one who is purified and one whose deeds are accepted

duas.context: When studying or seeking knowledge
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاَغْفِرْ لِي وَ ارْحَمْنِي وَ عَلِّمْنِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma faghfir li warhamni wa allimni
duas.text: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, and grant me knowledge

duas.context: When making a decision
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَ أَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika wa astaqdiruka biqudratika
duas.text: O Allah, I seek Your counsel through Your knowledge and Your power

duas.context: When eating
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنا وَ قِنا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fimar razalta wa qina adhaban-nar
duas.text: O Allah, bless us in what You have provided for us and protect us from the punishment of the Fire

duas.context: When waking up
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنا وَ إِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillah alladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilaihin-nushur
duas.text: Praise be to Allah, who has given us life after having taken it from us, and to Him is the return

duas.context: When going to bed
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَ أَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bismika amutu wa ahya
duas.text: O Allah, I die and I live in Your name

duas.context: When giving advice
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنا بِحَلاَلٍ وَ عَافِنا مِنَ الْحَرَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aghnina bihalalin wa afina minal-haram
duas.text: O Allah, make us self-sufficient with what is lawful and protect us from what is unlawful

duas.context: When experiencing hardship
duas.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu al-azim al-halim la ilaha illallahu rabbul-arshil-azim
duas.text: There is no deity except Allah, the Great, the Forbearing. There is no deity except Allah, the Lord of the Great Throne

duas.context: When visiting the sick
duas.arabic: لا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun in sha'Allah
duas.text: No harm, (the patient will be) purified, if Allah wills

duas.context: When seeing someone who is afflicted
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَبْقَانا وَ لَمْ يُمِتْنا
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillah alladhi abqana wa lam yumitna
duas.text: Praise be to Allah, who has given us life and not taken it from us

duas.context: When giving charity
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ طِبْ قَلْبِي وَ أَطِبْ سَمْعِي وَ بَصَرِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma tib qalbi wa atib sam'i wa basari
duas.text: O Allah, heal my heart and my hearing and my sight

duas.context: When in need of provision
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَزُقْنِي مِنْ حَلاَلِكَ وَ عَافِنِي مِنْ حَرَامِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ruzqni min halalik wa afini min haramik
duas.text: O Allah, provide for me from what is lawful and protect me from what is unlawful

duas.context: When seeing a beautiful creation
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَكْثَرَ مَا تَخَلَّقَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَ تَطَوَّرَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ma akthara ma takhallaqa min khalqik wa tatawara min ibadik
duas.text: O Allah, how many of Your creatures are there and how many of Your servants there are

duas.context: When experiencing sadness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُزَعِ وَ الْهَمِّ وَ الْعَوزِ وَ الْبُخْلِ وَ الضَّلَالَةِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-juz'i wal-hammi wal-uzi wal-bukhli wal-dalalati
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from despair and anxiety and poverty and miserliness and misguidance

duas.context: When in a gathering
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنا فِيمَا جَمَعَنا وَ فَرَّقَنا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fimaj jama'ana wa farraqna
duas.text: O Allah, bless us in what has brought us together and what has separated us

duas.context: When traveling
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَ الْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar wal-khalifatu fil-ahl
duas.text: O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Successor among the family

duas.context: When experiencing fear
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخَوْفِ وَ الْجُزَعِ وَ الْقِلَّةِ وَ الذُلِّ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khawfi wal-juz'i wal-qillati wadhdhulli
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from fear and despair and poverty and humiliation

duas.context: When in need of guidance
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ دَلِّعَلى رُشْدِي وَ أَعِنِّي عَلى طَاعَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma dalli ala rushdi wa a'inni ala ta'atika
duas.text: O Allah, guide me to what is right and help me to obey You

duas.context: When seeing a miracle
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Subhanallahi al-azim
duas.text: Glory be to Allah, the Great

duas.context: When remembering Allah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَذْهَبْ عَنِّي الْهَمَّ وَ الْغَمَّ وَ أَخْلِفْ عَلَيَّ النُّعْمَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma adhhab anni al-hamma wal-ghamma wa akhlif alayyan-ni'ma
duas.text: O Allah, take away from me anxiety and sorrow and grant me well-being

duas.context: When seeking forgiveness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ وَ الْمُعَافَاةَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-afiata wal-mu'afata
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for well-being and pardon

duas.context: When experiencing gratitude
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلى كُلِّ حَالٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma laka al-hamdu ala kulli hal
duas.text: O Allah, praise be to You in every situation

duas.context: When in a state of happiness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta wa anna Muhammadan rasuluka
duas.text: O Allah, I bear witness that there is no deity except You and that Muhammad is Your Messenger

duas.context: When seeking protection
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min adhabi jahannama wa min adhabi al-qabr
duas.text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell and the punishment of the grave

duas.context: When experiencing joy
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْنِي مِنْ رِزْقِكَ الْوَاسِعِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma at'imni min rizqikal-wasi'i
duas.text: O Allah, feed me from Your abundant provision

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
duas.text: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾.) (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾.) (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾)
duas.text: ([Soorah al-Ikhlaas (112)]( 1 )   Say, He is Allah, [who is] One,( 2 )   Allah, the Eternal Refuge.( 3 )   He neither begets nor is born,( 4 )   Nor is there to Him any equivalent.)([Soorah al-Falaq (113)] ( 1 )   Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak( 2 )   From the evil of that which He created( 3 )   And from the evil of darkness when it settles( 4 )   And from the evil of the blowers in knots( 5 )   And from the evil of an envier when he envies. )([Soorah an-Naas (114)])( 1 )   Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,( 2 )   The Sovereign of mankind.( 3 )   The God of mankind,( 4 )   From the evil of the retreating whisperer -( 5 )   Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -( 6 )   From among the jinn and mankind.
duas.source: Then recite [Soorah al-Ikhlaas (112)], [Soorah al-Falaq (113)] and [Soorah an-Naas (114)]

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي  هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ)). [ وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه] [وإذا أمسى قال: رب أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة، وخير ما بعدها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة، وشر ما بعدها.]
duas.text: ‘We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allaah, belongs all sovereignty , and all praise is for Allaah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, alone, without any partner, to Him belong all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it . My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.’
duas.source: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillah walhamdu lillah la ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra ma fee hathihil-laylah, wakhayra ma baAAdaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri hathihil-laylah, washarri ma baAAdaha, rabbi aAAoothu bika minal-kasal, wasoo-il kibar, rabbi aAAoothu bika min AAathabin fin-nar, waAAathabin fil-qabr.‘We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah.  None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it.  My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility.  My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.’…likewise, one says in the morning:Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillah….‘We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty…’

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا ، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم بك أمسينا، وبك أصبحنا، وبك نحيا، وبك نموت، وإليك المصير.]
duas.text: (O Allah, by your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection.)[In the evening:](O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return.)
duas.source: (Allahumma bika asbahna wabika amsayna, wabika nahya ,wabika namootu wa-ilaykan-nushoor.)[In the evening:] (Allahumma bika amsayna, wabika asbahna, wabika nahya wabika namootu wa-ilaykal-maseer.)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed.  I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.)
duas.source: (Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa-ana AAabduk, wa-ana AAala AAahdika wawaAAdika mas-tataAAt, aAAoothu bika min sharri ma sanaAAt, aboo-o laka biniAAmatika AAalay, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ)) (أربعَ مَرَّاتٍ).[ وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم إني أمسيت...]
duas.text: (O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angles, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.) (four times in the morning & evening)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsaytu) instead of (asbahtu).)
duas.source: (Allahumma innee asbahtu oshhiduk, wa-oshhidu hamalata AAarshik, wamala-ikatak, wajameeAAa khalqik, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluk .) (four times in the morning & evening)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsaytu) instead of (asbahtu).)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم ما أمسى بي...]
duas.text: (O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon, is from You alone, without partner, so for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.)(…whoever says this in the morning has indeed offered his day’s thanks and whoever says this in the evening has indeed offered his night’s thanks.)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsa) instead of (asbaha).)
duas.source: (Allahumma ma asbaha bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqik, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsa) instead of (asbaha).)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ  إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.text: (O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health.  None has the right to be worshipped except You.)(three times) (O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave.  None has the right to be worshipped except You. (three times))
duas.source: (Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa ant.(three times).)(Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufr, walfaqr, wa-aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant (three times).)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ)) (سَبْعَ مَرّاتٍ).
duas.text: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.’ (Recite seven times in Arabic.)
duas.source: (Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem (Recite seven times in Arabic.)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ: فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَينِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي)).
duas.text: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and set at ease my dismay. O Allah, preserve me from the front and from behind and on my right and on my left and from above, and I take refuge with You lest I be swallowed up by the earth.
duas.source: Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah, fid-dunya wal-akhirah, allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah fee deenee, wadunyaya wa-ahlee, wamalee, allahummas-tur AAawratee, wa-amin rawAAatee, allahummah-fathnee min bayni yaday, wamin khalfee, waAAan yameenee, waAAan shimalee, wamin fawqee, wa-aAAoothu biAAathamatika an oghtala min tahtee.

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى  نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.)(shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him.  This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)
duas.source: (Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, waan aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.text: (In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing.’(three times))
duas.source: (Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on fil-ardi wala fis-sama-i wahuwas-sameeAAul-AAaleem. (three times).)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيّاً)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.text: (I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Islam as a religion and Muhammad  as a Prophet.’(three times))
duas.source: (Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin  nabiyya. (three times))

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ)).
duas.text: (O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance, rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye.)
duas.source: (Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha/nee kullah, wala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn.)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُـمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ:فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه ربّ العالمين اللَّهم إني أسألك خير هذه الليلة: فتحها، ونصرها، ونورها، وبركتها، وهداها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما فيها، وشر ما بعدها.]
duas.text: (We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it.)[For the evening, the supplication is read as follows:](We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of tonight, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of tonight and the evil that follows it.)
duas.source: (Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathal-yawm, fat-hahu, wanasrahu, wanoorahu, wabarakatahu, wahudahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feehi, washarri ma baAAdah.)[For the evening, the supplication is read as follows: ](Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathihil-laylah, fat-haha, wanasraha, wanooraha, wabarakataha, wahudaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feeha washarri ma baAAdaha.)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((أَصْبَحْنا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا على فطرة الإسلام...]
duas.text: (We rise upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad  and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah.)(fitrah: the religion of Islam, the way of Ibraheem u.)(Note: for the evening, one reads amsayna instead of asbahna.)
duas.source: (Asbahna AAala fitratil-islam, waAAala kalimatil-ikhlas, waAAala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad  waAAala millati abeena Ibraheem, haneefan musliman wama kana minal-mushrikeen.)(Note: for the evening, one reads amsayna instead of asbahna.)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ)) (مائة مرَّةٍ).
duas.text: (How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.)(one hundred times)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)) (عشرَ مرَّات) ، أَوْ (مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.)( [ten times or once if lazy])
duas.source: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.  [ten times or once if lazy])

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)) (مائةَ مرَّةٍ إذا أصبحَ).
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.)((one hundred times every day))
duas.source: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer. (one hundred times every day))

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أصبحَ).
duas.text: (How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words.)(three times)
duas.source: (Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, AAadada khalqihi warida nafsih, wazinata AAarshih, wamidada kalimatih.)(three times)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً)) (إذا أصبحَ).
duas.text: (O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.)
duas.source: (Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ)) (مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ فِي الْيَوْمِ).
duas.text: ‘I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.’ [one hundred times a day]
duas.source: Astaghfirullaaha wa 'atoobu 'ilayhi[one hundred times a day]

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أمسى).
duas.text: (I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created.)(three times in the evening)
duas.source: (aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.) (three times in the evening)

duas.context: Words of remembrance for morning and evening
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبَيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ)) (عشرَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.text: ‘O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.’ [ten times]
duas.source: Allaahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin[ten times]

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ((يَجْمَعُ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ يَنْفُثُ فِيهِمَا فَيَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا:بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾.  بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾.  بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾ ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ)) (يفعلُ ذلك ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.text: (When retiring to his bed every night, the Prophet  would hold his palms together, spit (A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle) in them, recite the last three chapters (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas) of the Quran and then wipe over his entire body as much as possible with his hands, beginning with his head and face and then all parts of the body, he would do this three times.)

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْـــــــــــدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
duas.transliteration: allahu la ilaha illa huwa, al-hayyul-qayyum. la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnihi. ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum. wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. wa si'a kursiyyuhu as-samawati wal-ard. wa la ya'udu-hu hifdhuhuma. wa huwa al-'aliyyul-'azim
duas.text: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾.
duas.text: ( 285 )   The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say, We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination.( 286 )   Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.source: Recite last two verses of Soorah (Al-Baqarah :285-286)

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ((بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ)).
duas.text: (In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants.)
duas.source: (Bismika rabbee wadaAAtu janbee wabika arfaAAuh, fa-in amsakta nafsee farhamha, wa-in arsaltaha fahfathha bima tahfathu bihi AAibadakas-saliheen.)

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, verily You have created my soul and You shall take it’s life, to You belongs it’s life and death. If You should keep my soul alive then protect it, and if You should take it’s life then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You to grant me good health.)
duas.source: (Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsee wa-anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wamahyaha in ahyaytaha fahfathha, wa-in amattaha faghfir laha. Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafiyah.)

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected.)

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ((بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا)).
duas.transliteration: bismika allahumma amutu wa ahya
duas.text: (In Your name O Allah, I live and die.)

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (أربعاً وثلاثينَ))).
duas.text: (How Perfect Allah is. (thirty-three times) All praise is for Allah.(thirty-three times) Allah is the greatest.(thirty-four times))
duas.source: (Subhanal-lah. (thirty-three times) Alhamdu lillah. (thirty-three times) Allahu akbar. (thirty-four times))

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injeel and the Furqan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock (i.e. You have total mastery over). O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You.You are Aththahir so there is nothing above You and You are Al-Batin so there is nothing closer than You.Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty.)(Tawrah: The book revealed to Moosa u.)(Injeel: The book revealed to Easa u.)(Furqan: One of the many names of the Quran, means: The Criterion which distinguishes between truth and falsehood.)(Aththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.)
duas.source: (Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAA, warabbal-AAarshil-AAatheem, rabbana warabba kulli shay/, faliqal-habbi wannawa, wamunazzilat-tawra, wal-injeel, walfurqan, aAAoothu bika min sharri kulli shayin anta akhithun binasiyatih. Allahumma antal-awwal, falaysa qablaka shay/, wa-antal-akhir, falaysa baAAdaka shay/, wa-antath-thahir falaysa fawqaka shay/, waantal-batin, falaysa doonaka shay/, iqdi AAannad-dayna wa-aghnina minal-faqr.)

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ)).
duas.text: (All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.)
duas.source: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamana wasaqana, wakafana, wa-awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wala mu'wee.)

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You.  I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.)(shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him.  This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)
duas.source: (Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, wa-an aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.)

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ((يَقْرَأُ ﴿الم﴾ تَنْزِيلَ السَّجْدَة ِ،  وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ)).
duas.text: (The Prophet  never used to sleep until he had recited Soorat As-Sajdah (chapter 32) and Soorat Al-Mulk (chapter 67).)

duas.context: What to say before sleeping
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ)).
duas.text: (O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, and I entrust my affair unto You, and I turn my face towards You, and I totally rely on You, in hope and fear of You.Verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You.  I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.)(If you then die, you will die upon the fitrah.)(fitrah: the religion of Islam, the way of Ibraheem u.)
duas.source: (Allahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wafawwadtu amree ilayk, wawajjahtu wajhee ilayk, wa-alja/tu thahree ilayk, raghbatan warahbatan ilayk, la maljaa wala manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikal-lathee anzalt, wabinabiyyikal-lathee arsalt.)

duas.context: supplications for when you wake up
duas.arabic: (.الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ )
duas.transliteration: alhamdulillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
duas.text: (All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.)
duas.source: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee ahyana baAAda ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushoor.)

duas.context: supplications for when you wake up
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَريكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفرْ لِي
duas.text: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without associate, to Him belongs sovereignty and praise and He is over all things wholly capable.  How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with Allah, The Most High, The Supreme.O my Lord forgive me)
duas.source: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer, subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala  ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAaliyyil AAatheem. Rabbigh-fir lee)

duas.context: supplications for when you wake up
duas.arabic: ( الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِهِ )
duas.text: (All praise is for Allah who restored to me my health and returned my soul and  has allowed me to remember Him.)
duas.source: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee fee jasadee waradda AAalayya roohee wa-athina lee bithikrih.)

duas.context: supplications for when you wake up
duas.arabic: ﴿ إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لأُوْلِي الألْبَابِ * الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَاماً وَقُعُوداً وَعَلَىَ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذا بَاطِلاً سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ* رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ* رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِياً يُنَادِي لِلإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأبْرَارِ* رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ* فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لاَ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَى بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ وَأُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُواْ فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُواْ وَقُتِلُواْ لأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ ثَوَاباً مِّن عِندِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ * لاَ يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي الْبِلاَدِ * مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ * لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلاً مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلأَبْرَارِ * وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لاَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَناً قَلِيلاً أُوْلَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ*يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ اصْبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ﴾
duas.text: ( 190 )   Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding.( 191 )   Who remember Allah while standing or sitting or [lying] on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying], Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.( 192 )   Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.( 193 )   Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.( 194 )   Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.( 195 )   And their Lord responded to them, Never will I allow to be lost the work of [any] worker among you, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated or were evicted from their homes or were harmed in My cause or fought or were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds, and I will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow as reward from Allah, and Allah has with Him the best reward.( 196 )   Be not deceived by the [uninhibited] movement of the disbelievers throughout the land.( 197 )   [It is but] a small enjoyment; then their [final] refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place.( 198 )   But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as accommodation from Allah. And that which is with Allah is best for the righteous.( 199 )   And indeed, among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah and what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, [being] humbly submissive to Allah. They do not exchange the verses of Allah for a small price.Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, Allah is swift in account.( 200 )   O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.
duas.source: From Verse 3:190 till the end of the chapter Al-Imran

duas.context: Invocation for entering the restroom
duas.arabic: ([بِسْمِ اللَّهِ] اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبائِث).
duas.text: ((In the name of Allah).  O Allah, I take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.)
duas.source: ((Bismil-lah) allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba-ith.)

duas.context: Invocation for leaving the restroom
duas.arabic: (غُفْرَانَكَ).
duas.transliteration: ghufranak
duas.text: (I ask You (Allah) for forgiveness.)

duas.context: What to say before performing ablution
duas.arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ).
duas.text: (In the name of Allah.)

duas.context: What to say upon completing ablution
duas.arabic: (أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ..).
duas.text: (I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.)
